parse_headers(lines) parses RFC-style header lines: trim surrounding whitespace, split at the first colon, lowercase names, preserve value case, join a line beginning with space/tab to the previous value with one space. Repeated names become lists in arrival order. Ignore blank lines. Invalid lines and continuation without a prior header raise ValueError.
